false.definition: No: the line is not the outer-skin apex of a formed fold.
not_bends: The wall or rim of a hole, slot or cutout.
A sheet-thickness edge or the outer perimeter of the part (a cut edge, not a fold).
An emboss, bead, rib or dimple pressed into a flat face.
A gentle kink or curvature on a rolled or curved surface, with no distinct fold.
Scan noise, an artifact, a registration seam or fixture geometry.
The inner skin of a fold, or a copy of a fold line offset from it by about one sheet thickness.

counts_as_a_bend: Two flat flanges that meet at a formed fold, at any formed angle.
Small formed bends of about 15 to 30 deg count as bends.
A joggle (offset step) is two bends: each of its two folds is a real bend line.
A fold interrupted by a window or relief cut is still the same bend; a stretch of it counts.
true.definition: Yes: the line runs along a fold that was formed on a press brake, on the outer (convex) skin at the apex of the fold.

instructions.how_to_read_the_state: `state` describes one candidate line found on a 3-D scan of a sheet-metal part. It has no coordinates. `state.candidate` holds measurements taken on the scan around the line: each one has a `value`, a `unit` and a `meaning`, and some have a `reading` that puts the value in words. Cross-section slices are cut across the line at evenly spaced points along it. `state.surroundings` describes other candidate lines on the same scan.
instructions.question: Is the candidate line in `state.candidate` the outer-skin apex of a real formed press-brake bend?

apex.about_this_group: Where the line sits on the fold.

apex_side.meaning: Where the material lies relative to the line, towards the inside of the fold angle: positive means the line is on the convex outer skin, about minus one sheet thickness means the concave inner skin.

bend_radius_estimate.meaning: Bend radius from cylinder fits to the scan near the line, when available.

corner_gap.meaning: Gap between the sharp corner where the two flange planes would meet and the nearest scanned surface; a rounded formed bend leaves a gap of about its outer radius, a sharp cut edge leaves almost none.

line_to_corner.meaning: Distance from the line to the sharp corner where the two flange planes would meet; a line on the apex of a formed bend sits within a few mm of it.

cross_section.about_this_group: What a slice cut across the line shows around it.

closed_ring_slices.meaning: Share of slices where material surrounds the line on all sides, as inside a hole wall or a tube.

empty_slices.meaning: Share of slices with almost no scan points around the line.

many_flange_slices.meaning: Share of slices with three or more separate pieces of material around the line.

one_flange_slices.meaning: Share of slices with material on one side of the line only, as at a cut edge.

two_flange_slices.meaning: Share of cross-section slices along the line that show two separate flanges meeting at the line.

flanges.about_this_group: The two pieces of sheet on either side of the line.

flange_balance.meaning: Points on the smaller flange divided by points on the larger flange (1 = equal).

flatter_flange_fit_residual.meaning: RMS distance of the flatter flange's points from a straight line in the slice; small means flat.

longer_flange_width.meaning: Visible width of the wider flange next to the line (measured up to 40 mm).

rougher_flange_fit_residual.meaning: RMS distance of the rougher flange's points from a straight line in the slice; small means flat.

shorter_flange_width.meaning: Visible width of the narrower flange next to the line (measured up to 40 mm).

fold_angle.about_this_group: The angle between the two flanges, where two flanges are seen.

angle_spread.meaning: Interquartile range of the angle along the line; small means the angle is constant.

angle_stability.meaning: Share of two-flange slices whose angle is within 5 deg of the median angle.

bend_angle.meaning: How far the sheet turns at the line: 0 is flat, 90 is a right-angle fold (median over two-flange slices).

normal_switch_angle.meaning: Angle between the two surface-normal directions on either side of the line.

surface_normal_switch.meaning: How clearly the scanned surface normals switch between two distinct flat directions across the line: 1 is a clean two-sided fold, 0 is no switch.

support.about_this_group: How well the scan supports the line.

corridor_coverage.meaning: Share of the line's length with scan points in the corridor around it.

distance_to_surface.meaning: Median distance from the line to the nearest scanned point.

line_support.meaning: Share of the line that has scan points directly on it.

points_near_line_distance.meaning: Median distance of the scan points in a narrow corridor around the line from the line itself.

surroundings.about_this_group: Other candidate lines found on the same scan.

collinear_partners.meaning: Other candidates on the same straight carrier line, separated by a gap of up to 80 mm (as when a window or relief interrupts one fold).

near_identical_proposals.meaning: Other candidate proposals lying almost on this line (parallel, within 4 mm, overlapping): independent detections of the same feature.

parallel_lines_6_to_40mm.meaning: Other parallel candidates 6 to 40 mm away (for example the other fold of a joggle, or a hem).

parallel_lines_within_6mm.meaning: Other candidate lines parallel to this one and 0.4 to 6 mm away (possible other skin of the same fold).
